metadata.datasetName: Zenve Vet Complete Social, Network & Messaging Demo Data
metadata.purpose: Complete review dataset for approval before mapping/importing into the existing Django/MySQL schema.
importantNotes: This is a review JSON, not a direct MySQL dump. Map every collection to actual Django models before importing.
All user identities, doctor profile details, individual likes/comments, connections, messages, and notifications are synthetic demo data.
Emails use example.test and cannot be used for real login. Password hashes are omitted.
Doctor qualifications, experience, clinic names, addresses, websites, and bios are illustrative placeholders; verify or replace them before production.
Individual postLikes and postComments are generated to match each source post likesCount/commentsCount exactly. Comment text is illustrative.
Connection state is stored separately from conversations. Existing accepted connections can message without sending a new request.
Direct and group conversations use conversationParticipants; messages persist independently and can be paginated by conversation and timestamp.
Clinical cases are marked anonymized in the supplied mock data; never add real client or patient identifiers to demo data.
No database or backend has been changed by generating this file.
metadata.mediaSource: Pexels veterinary stock photos and veterinary video source pages
metadata.mediaNote: Demo data only. Image URLs point to Pexels image CDN. Video URLs point to Pexels video pages, not direct MP4 streams; they must be replaced with verified direct video URLs or downloaded licensed assets before using an HTML video player. Stock photos must not be represented as real doctors’ identity photos.
